facts.fact: In the margin beside three lines of Ittan's tally book is a tiny inked sunbird with folded wings, distinct from the queen's spread-winged seal; Neela cannot read it as guild shorthand.
facts.why: needed because the beat plants a sunbird mark that means nothing to her yet

facts.fact: Chathu enters every contract in the ledger against the subject's page, so Asha's contract entry is in the black book.
facts.why: needed because Devan needs the guild's contract for Asha as court evidence

facts.fact: Ittan's tally book shows four payment slashes to the Resin House and a 'hook' mark meaning something delivered in return.
facts.why: needed to show Neela reading guild shorthand on the page

facts.fact: Neela always takes the east stair and avoids the west stair without stating a reason.
facts.why: plants her unease for the later lookout reveal without contradicting that she does not know which fort

facts.fact: Ammu's pouch held a thumb of resin of which two smears remain on the ninth day of the rains.
facts.why: needed because the beat sets the resin clock at two smears
